facts.text: Owners T and C Hughes (applicants) and Wellington City Council (authority) concern a code compliance certificate for alterations to a house at 60 Nevay Road, Wellington.
The building envelope in scope includes wall claddings, windows, roof cladding, decks and flashings, and the way the components are installed and work together.
The authority stated that the applicants may apply to modify Clause B2.3.1 so that durability periods start at substantial completion; the determination leaves that to the parties.
The determination relies on reports from a building surveyor and a structural engineer engaged by the applicants.
